schematicCoverage.limitation: Alternate-unit links require complete saved root project annotations, consistent placed library/footprint/value and distinct valid units, with exactly one explicit PCB UUID/path anchor; display Reference labels are not used to form aliases.

associationSources.supports: Saved symbol instance paths carry project-specific reference and unit annotation.
CollectOtherUnits identifies native other units using instance reference, library ID and a different unit index.
AppendMultiUnitSymbol groups native project multi-unit references, respecting reused sheet channels.
